items.front: How fast does cwnd grow during slow start?
items.back: It doubles every round trip, which is exponential growth.
When cwnd reaches ssthresh or a loss occurs.

items.front: What do three duplicate ACKs trigger in TCP Reno?
items.back: Fast retransmit followed by fast recovery, halving cwnd.

items.front: What is the congestion window, cwnd?
items.back: The congestion window limiting unacknowledged bytes in flight.
